summary.zh: HanaKDE v0.0.10 新增完整的档案工作台，让个人、组织和项目资料可以在当前工作区中归集、检索、恢复并便携迁移。
summary.en: HanaKDE v0.0.10 adds a complete Dossiers workbench for collecting, searching, recovering, and portably moving personal, organization, and project records inside the current workspace.

title.zh: 新增 Hana Dossiers 档案工作台

summary.zh: 现在可以创建个人、组织和项目档案，在统一目录中维护类型化属性、独立联系人和元数据搜索，并通过完整页面持续操作。
summary.en: You can now create personal, organization, and project dossiers, manage typed properties and reusable contacts, and search metadata from a dedicated full-page workbench.

details.zh: 档案保存在当前工作区固定的 Dossiers 目录中，目录清单保持可读、可复制和可迁移。
details.en: Dossiers live in the current workspace's dedicated Dossiers directory, with readable manifests that remain copyable and portable.

details.zh: 桌面和窄屏布局均支持创建、搜索、详情编辑和键盘操作。
details.en: Desktop and narrow layouts both support creation, search, detail editing, and keyboard operation.

sources.title: feat(dossiers): add catalog and contacts (T-02)
feat(dossiers): compose plugin page and host e2e

title.zh: 资料归集具备冗余与便携迁移能力
title.en: Managed documents gain resilient, portable intake

summary.zh: 外部或工作区内文件都会复制进档案的受管目录并按分类归集，同时提供哈希去重、安全 ZIP 导入导出和整库目录迁移。
summary.en: Files from outside or inside the workspace are copied into managed dossier storage and classified, with hash deduplication, safe ZIP exchange, and whole-library folder migration.

details.zh: 导入先预检路径、冲突、分类和哈希，确认后再发布权威写入，中断不会留下半成品。
details.en: Import previews paths, conflicts, classification, and hashes before confirmation, and interrupted writes do not publish partial results.

details.zh: 单档案 ZIP 包含清单、联系人快照、资料和校验信息，可在另一工作区恢复。
details.en: Each dossier ZIP contains its manifest, contact snapshot, documents, and integrity metadata for restoration in another workspace.

sources.title: feat(dossiers): add managed document intake (T-03)
feat(dossiers): add portable zip exchange (T-06)

title.zh: Agent 按需读取，删除与迁移可恢复
title.en: On-demand Agent access with recoverable lifecycle operations

summary.zh: Agent 首次只获得档案元数据和相对引用，按任务需要读取资料；模型内容入口可关闭，删除、恢复和 schema 迁移均经过明确确认与恢复门。
summary.en: The Agent initially receives only dossier metadata and relative references, reading documents when a task requires them; model content access can be disabled, while deletion, recovery, and schema migration use explicit confirmation and recovery gates.

details.zh: 插件不会在页面打开或资料导入后后台扫描正文，也不会自动把建议写入权威档案。
details.en: The plugin does not scan document content in the background after opening the page or importing files, and suggestions never write authoritative data automatically.

details.zh: 回收站、保留期、审计日志、迁移备份与 journal 共同保护工作区权威数据。
details.en: Trash retention, audit records, migration backups, and journals protect authoritative workspace data.

sources.title: feat(dossiers): add agent tools and model boundary (T-04)
feat(dossiers): add trash recovery and audit retention (T-05)
feat(dossiers): add recoverable schema migration (T-08)

summary.zh: HanaKDE v0.0.9 让知识页彻底收敛到共享文件工作台，移除两个已拒绝的实验插件，并恢复 Todo 的后台、系统 UI 与 AI 工具链。
summary.en: HanaKDE v0.0.9 fully converges Knowledge on the shared file workbench, removes two rejected experimental plugins, and restores Todo's backend, system UI, and AI toolchain.

title.zh: 知识页收敛到共享文件工作台
title.en: Knowledge converges on the shared file workbench

summary.zh: 知识页直接复用 DeskSection、PreviewPanel 和文件变更桥，删除平行 Explorer/Editor 实现，同时保留 Knowledge 索引、恢复和 ResourceIO 能力。
summary.en: Knowledge now directly reuses DeskSection, PreviewPanel, and the file-change bridge, removing its parallel Explorer/Editor implementation while preserving Knowledge indexing, recovery, and ResourceIO capabilities.

details.zh: Markdown 和其他受支持文件继续沿用聊天工作台已有的打开、编辑、保存、标签与文件命令链路。
details.en: Markdown and other supported files continue through the chat workbench's established open, edit, save, tab, and file-command paths.

sources.title: refactor(workbenches): converge upstream and complete Todo

title.zh: 移除已拒绝的实验工作台

summary.zh: Finance Workbench 与 Markdown WeChat 不再随应用打包或加载，并同步删除它们独占的页面能力与持久化登记。
summary.en: Finance Workbench and Markdown WeChat are no longer bundled or loaded, and their exclusive page capability and persistence registrations have been removed.

details.zh: 现有用户插件数据保持不变；Todo、其他内置插件和内部 Seed/OTA 完整性签名继续保留。
details.en: Existing user plugin data remains untouched; Todo, other built-in plugins, and internal Seed/OTA integrity signatures remain in place.

sources.title: refactor(workbenches): converge upstream and complete Todo

title.zh: Todo 后台与系统工作台恢复可用
title.en: Todo backend and system workbench restored

summary.zh: Todo 的任务后台在插件启动前就绪，增删改查、项目、提醒和周期任务可持久化工作，页面完整继承 Hana 系统视觉与交互合同。
summary.en: Todo's task backend is ready before plugin startup, persisted CRUD, projects, reminders, and recurrence work end to end, and the page fully inherits Hana's system visual and interaction contract.

details.zh: AI 获得 16 个经过权限约束的 Todo 工具；页面请求具备超时、取消、重试与真实 HTTP/磁盘 CRUD 覆盖。
details.en: AI receives 16 permission-scoped Todo tools, while page requests now have timeout, cancellation, retry, and real HTTP/disk CRUD coverage.

sources.title: refactor(workbenches): converge upstream and complete Todo

title.zh: 同步 DeepSeek V4 Responses 能力

summary.zh: 沿用 upstream v0.450.0 的模型目录与 Responses 适配，补齐 DeepSeek V4 Flash、Pro、Vision 元数据和官方 thinking 档位。
summary.en: The model catalog and Responses adapter now reuse upstream v0.450.0 behavior, adding DeepSeek V4 Flash, Pro, Vision metadata and the official thinking ladder.

details.zh: Vision 能力与 thinking level 通过模型和 provider 兼容性测试固定。
details.en: Vision capability and thinking levels are pinned by model and provider compatibility tests.

sources.title: refactor(workbenches): converge upstream and complete Todo

summary.zh: HanaKDE v0.0.8 让知识页直接复用完整文件工作台，恢复 Markdown 编辑和文件命令，并修复 Finance Workbench、Markdown WeChat 与 Todo 插件页面无限加载。
summary.en: HanaKDE v0.0.8 reuses the complete file workbench in Knowledge, restores Markdown editing and file commands, and fixes endless loading in Finance Workbench, Markdown WeChat, and Todo.

title.zh: 知识页恢复完整文件编辑
title.en: Complete file editing restored in Knowledge

summary.zh: 知识页现在直接使用聊天工作台已有的文件树、标签页和 PreviewPanel，Markdown、代码及其他受支持文件重新可以打开、编辑和保存。
summary.en: Knowledge now uses the existing file tree, tabs, and PreviewPanel from the chat workbench, so Markdown, code, and other supported files can be opened, edited, and saved again.

details.zh: 工作区身份、文件监控、冲突处理与标签状态共用同一套 store 和 actions，不再维护平行编辑器。
details.en: Workspace identity, file watching, conflict handling, and tab state now share the same stores and actions instead of a parallel editor.

sources.title: fix(workbench): restore knowledge editing and plugin pages

title.zh: 文件右键命令补全

summary.zh: 文件树新增复制、剪切、粘贴及对应快捷键，并继续复用既有重命名和删除链路；复制目录时会安全处理重名和自包含目标。
summary.en: The file tree adds copy, cut, paste, and matching shortcuts while retaining the existing rename and delete paths, with safe collision and self-descendant handling for directory copies.

details.zh: 陈旧的回收操作日志在原文件与回收载荷均不存在时会安全终结，不再永久禁用当前工作区编辑。
details.en: Stale trash operation journals now finalize safely when neither the original nor trash payload remains, preventing permanent editor lockout.

sources.title: fix(workbench): restore knowledge editing and plugin pages

title.zh: 三个内置插件页面恢复加载
title.en: Three built-in plugin pages load again

summary.zh: Finance Workbench、Markdown WeChat 和 Todo 在桌面端可以加载真实业务界面，不再停留在空白页和旋转加载状态。
summary.en: Finance Workbench, Markdown WeChat, and Todo now load their real desktop interfaces instead of remaining blank with an endless spinner.

details.zh: 插件 iframe 只在真实 load/handshake 后进入 ready，并通过短时签名资源路径兼容 macOS Electron 的 file:// 宿主。
details.en: Plugin iframes become ready only after a real load or handshake and use short-lived signed asset paths compatible with the macOS Electron file:// host.

sources.title: fix(workbench): restore knowledge editing and plugin pages

summary.zh: HanaKDE v0.0.7 修复 macOS 实验包因签名 Team ID 不一致而无法启动的问题，并在发布前验证 macOS 与 Windows 原始未签名产物。
summary.en: HanaKDE v0.0.7 fixes a macOS launch failure caused by mismatched signing Team IDs and verifies untouched unsigned macOS and Windows packages before release.

title.zh: 无证书实验包恢复启动

summary.zh: macOS 桌面壳不再混用旧平台签名身份，避免 Electron Framework 因 Team ID 不一致在启动阶段被系统拒绝。
summary.en: The macOS desktop shell no longer mixes legacy platform signing identities, preventing Team ID mismatches from blocking Electron Framework during launch.

details.zh: macOS 实验包保持无 Developer ID、无公证；确认来源后清除 quarantine 即可启动，内部 Seed/OTA 完整性签名继续保留。
details.en: The experimental macOS package remains free of Developer ID signing and notarization; after verifying the source, users can clear quarantine to launch it, while internal Seed/OTA integrity signatures remain intact.

details.zh: 发布流程现在会原样启动 macOS DMG，并要求 Windows 安装器与主程序的 Authenticode 状态为 NotSigned；测试不再通过重签掩盖产物问题。
details.en: The release flow now launches untouched macOS DMGs and requires Windows installers and executables to report Authenticode NotSigned; tests can no longer hide package defects by re-signing them.

sources.title: fix(release): remove platform signing from experimental builds

summary.zh: HanaKDE v0.0.6 是一次维护发布，不包含新的用户可见功能或行为变化。
summary.en: HanaKDE v0.0.6 is a maintenance release with no new user-facing features or behavior changes.

summary.zh: HanaKDE v0.0.5 新增 Markdown 公众号排版与个人量化金融研究工作台，并完善插件页面的导出和跳转体验。
summary.en: HanaKDE v0.0.5 adds Markdown publishing and personal quantitative finance research workbenches, with complete export and navigation flows for plugin pages.

title.zh: Markdown 公众号排版工作台

summary.zh: 在 HanaKDE 中编辑 Markdown、实时预览公众号样式，并通过富文本复制或浏览器下载交付排版结果。
summary.en: Edit Markdown, preview publication-ready styling live, and deliver formatted results through rich-text copy or browser downloads inside HanaKDE.

details.zh: Page、Widget 和 Agent tool 共用受权限保护的插件数据、资源导入和显式写回流程。
details.en: Page, Widget, and Agent tools share permission-scoped plugin data, resource import, and explicit write-back flows.

details.zh: Widget 可直接打开完整工作台，页面导出不再依赖聊天 Session。
details.en: The Widget can open the full workbench directly, and Page exports no longer depend on a chat Session.

sources.title: feat(plugins): add Markdown WeChat workbench
feat(markdown-wechat): open workspace from widget
fix(plugins): allow surface downloads
feat(plugins): add own-page navigation capability

title.zh: 个人量化金融研究工作台

summary.zh: 为 A 股和港股提供可追溯的数据研究、组合账本、筛选、因子策略、回测、监控与定时研究工作流。
summary.en: Research A-share and Hong Kong markets with traceable data, a portfolio ledger, screening, factor strategies, backtests, monitors, and scheduled research workflows.

details.zh: 数据源能力、质量、策略和运行 lineage 会被冻结并随证据记录，缺失或不完整数据不会被静默当成可用。
details.en: Provider capability, quality, policy, and run lineage are frozen with evidence; missing or incomplete data is never silently treated as usable.

details.zh: 私有材料和模型研究采用单次字段级授权；工作台永久保持 research-only，不提供下单或资金操作。
details.en: Private material and model research use one-run field-level consent; the workbench remains permanently research-only with no order or funds operations.

sources.title: feat(plugins): add finance workbench
fix(finance-workbench): build browser-safe UI bundle

summary.zh: HanaKDE v0.0.4 修复 Todo 页面加载、宿主鉴权和桌面及窄屏下的完整任务操作流程。
summary.en: HanaKDE v0.0.4 fixes Todo page loading, host authentication, and the complete task workflow on desktop and narrow layouts.

title.zh: Todo 宿主页面恢复可用

summary.zh: Todo 页面改用正式插件 SDK 完成 ready 握手和 surface-session 鉴权，快速记录、自动保存、完成、移入废纸篓及恢复在桌面和窄屏布局中均可正常使用。
summary.en: The Todo page now uses the official plugin SDK for the ready handshake and surface-session authentication, restoring capture, autosave, completion, Trash, and restore flows across desktop and narrow layouts.

details.zh: 构建缺少 SDK 依赖时会直接失败，不再生成无鉴权的退化页面资产。
details.en: Builds now fail when the SDK dependency is unavailable instead of producing an unauthenticated fallback page.

details.zh: 新建无日期 Todo 会进入可见的收集箱，窄屏导航会正确退出详情视图。
details.en: New unscheduled Todos move into the visible Inbox, and narrow-layout navigation now exits the detail view correctly.

sources.title: fix(todolist): restore authenticated host workflow

summary.zh: HanaKDE v0.0.3 完成产品品牌迁移，修复 Electron 开发运行时安装，并移除对上游 Apple 公证身份的依赖。
summary.en: HanaKDE v0.0.3 completes the product rebrand, fixes Electron development runtime installation, and removes the upstream Apple notarization dependency.

title.zh: 统一 HanaKDE 产品身份

summary.zh: 桌面端、安装器、独立核心资产、CLI、文档和发布门禁统一使用 HanaKDE 名称，同时保留旧数据与插件生态标识兼容。
summary.en: Desktop surfaces, installers, standalone core assets, CLI output, documentation, and release gates now use HanaKDE while legacy data and plugin ecosystem identifiers remain compatible.

sources.title: refactor(brand): rename product surfaces to HanaKDE

title.zh: Electron 开发运行时预检

summary.zh: 固定可工作的 Node/npm 工具链，在安装和桌面启动前显式安装并校验 Electron，避免 `path.txt` 缺失导致的启动失败。
summary.en: A working Node/npm toolchain is pinned and Electron is explicitly installed and verified before desktop startup, preventing missing `path.txt` failures.

sources.title: fix(dev): verify Electron runtime before startup

title.zh: 独立的未公证发行链

summary.zh: 删除 Apple Developer ID 公证钩子和凭据入口，保留不依赖上游证书的本地 Mach-O 与种子完整性签名。
summary.en: Apple Developer ID notarization hooks and credential inputs are removed while local Mach-O and seed integrity signing remain independent of upstream certificates.

sources.title: build(release): remove Apple notarization hook

summary.zh: Knowledge 工作区现在像 VS Code workspace 一样，在同一棵资源树中并列展示主目录和额外挂载目录，并与聊天工作台共享一致的文件树视觉。
summary.en: The Knowledge workspace now presents the main directory and additional mounts as sibling roots in one VS Code-style explorer, using the same file-tree presentation as the chat workbench.

title.zh: Knowledge 多根资源树

summary.zh: 移除重复的来源栏，把主目录与额外挂载目录作为同一 Explorer 的一级兄弟根，并显示真实目录名称。
summary.en: The duplicate Sources panel is removed, and the main directory and additional mounts now appear as sibling roots in one Explorer with their real directory names.

details.zh: Knowledge 与聊天工作台复用同一个树行 Renderer 和 HanaKDE 既有文件图标，统一行高、缩进、展开控件与长名称截断。
details.en: Knowledge and the chat workbench now share one tree-row renderer and HanaKDE's existing file icons, aligning row height, indentation, disclosure controls, and long-name truncation.

details.zh: 桌面与窄窗口布局均收敛为单一 Explorer，并保留选择、键盘导航、懒加载、拖拽和打开行为。
details.en: Desktop and narrow layouts both use a single Explorer while preserving selection, keyboard navigation, lazy loading, drag and drop, and open behavior.

sources.title: feat(knowledge): unify mounted roots in explorer

title.zh: 文件历史、差异与恢复

summary.zh: 从主工作区和文件树查看历史版本、比较差异并执行受保护的恢复操作。
summary.en: Inspect historical versions, compare changes, and perform guarded restores from the main workspace and file tree.

sources.title: feat(T-16): expose Workbench History flow

summary.zh: HanaKDE 首个公开版本带来完整的知识工作区、文件历史与内置待办工作台，并在保留这些二次开发能力的同时吸收 OpenHanako v0.449.0 的增强和修复。
summary.en: The first public HanaKDE release delivers the complete Knowledge Workspace, file history, and built-in Todo workbench while retaining these downstream capabilities alongside the enhancements and fixes from OpenHanako v0.449.0.

title.zh: 完整的知识工作区

summary.zh: 在统一工作区中浏览和编辑多来源资料，使用分组搜索、标签、引用、预览和安全的文件操作来组织知识。
summary.en: Browse and edit material from multiple sources in one workspace, with grouped search, tags, citations, previews, and guarded file operations.

details.zh: 支持 Markdown 编辑、实时预览、表格、代码块、数学公式和 Mermaid 图表。
details.en: Includes Markdown editing, live preview, tables, code blocks, math, and Mermaid diagrams.

details.zh: 索引、搜索与资源树在桌面端、Web Open 和 Web Full 入口保持一致。
details.en: Indexing, search, and the resource tree remain consistent across desktop, Web Open, and Web Full entry points.

sources.title: feat(knowledge): complete workspace release implementation
feat(knowledge): deliver source-grouped super search

title.zh: 内置待办工作台

summary.zh: 持久化待办插件覆盖创建、组织、重复任务、提醒、自动化运行以及导入导出，并提供完整工作台界面。
summary.en: The persistent Todo plugin covers capture, organization, recurrence, reminders, automation runs, import and export, with a complete workbench UI.

sources.title: Add the built-in todolist plugin and complete workbench

title.zh: 打包启动与 Windows 运行链加固
title.en: Hardened packaged startup and Windows runtime

summary.zh: 补齐运行依赖完整性检查、服务就绪诊断和 Windows 安装包直连门禁，减少安装后启动失败和残缺运行时。
summary.en: Runtime dependency integrity checks, server readiness diagnostics, and direct Windows installer gates reduce post-install startup failures and incomplete runtimes.

sources.title: fix(platform): harden packaged startup and Windows gates

title.zh: 吸收 OpenHanako v0.449.0

summary.zh: 通过保留合并拓扑的上游同步引入最新模型、更新器和稳定性改进，同时保留 HanaKDE 的 Knowledge、History、ResourceIO 与 Todo 所有权边界。
summary.en: A topology-preserving upstream merge brings in current model, updater, and stability improvements while retaining HanaKDE ownership boundaries for Knowledge, History, ResourceIO, and Todo.

details.zh: 包含 DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision 实验模型与声明图片能力模型的直接图像输入支持。
details.en: Includes the experimental DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision model and direct image input for models that declare image capability.

sources.title: merge(upstream): absorb OpenHanako v0.449.0
